Class MoleculeRegistrations

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.molecule.MoleculeRegistrations
public final class MoleculeRegistrations extends Object
Manages retained molecule source layers, owner registrations, and authoritative server snapshot publications.
